answer: An agent economy can require every new identity to post a refundable stake and win endorsements from established agents through unpredictable private whisper challenges. If an endorsed identity fails a later audit, its endorsers lose part of their own stake, making collusion expensive. A Sybil operator therefore must lock capital in every account and risk correlated slashing before gaining payment limits or influence; labels such as willow and ocean provide no shortcut through this bonded trust graph.
